text: The elastic scattering of light from microscopic density fluctuations, which scales as λ⁻⁴ and sets the ~0.14 dB/km fundamental loss floor of silica fiber near 1550 nm, is called ___ scattering.
explanation: Rayleigh scattering is elastic (no frequency shift) and its λ⁻⁴ dependence dominates the fiber loss minimum around 1550–1570 nm. Raman and Brillouin scattering, by contrast, are inelastic and shift the frequency by phonon energies.
